    As of April 10, 2026, BYD Company ADR (BYDDY) shares are trading around $13.44, showing a year-to-date recovery with a 52-week range of $11.20–$20.05. The stock is rated a Strong Buy with an average target price of $16.40–$22.00, driven by rapid overseas expansion and high March 2026 export figures. 
    Key Stock Highlights: 
    • Performance: The stock gained roughly 2.44% in recent trading sessions, supported by strong international sales, including over 120,000 NEVs exported in March 2026.
    • Valuation: BYD is frequently described as having an attractive valuation, with a forward P/E ratio near 18, which is lower than many competitors, suggesting it is undervalued
      .
    • Growth Drivers: The company is expanding its luxury presence with the Denza brand in Europe.
    • Risk Factors: Intense competition in China and potential trade tensions present risks to its domestic market share. 
    Analyst Sentiment:
    Analysts generally remain bullish on BYD (01211/BYDDY), citing it as a top pick among global EV manufacturers, with some advising that it is a better long-term choice compared to Tesla over the next five years.
